title: Recording: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings worked on the Venus And Mars song ‘Spirits Of Ancient Egypt’ on 19 February 1975.

This was the final session for the song. Over this and the previous day, Paul McCartney added Minimoog synth and Gizmo guitar parts, Linda McCartney added synth strings, Joe English recorded a gong to open the song, and Alan O’Duffy taped the busy signal from a telephone line for the song’s close. The song was completed with the whole band and O’Duffy recording harmony vocals.
